judged_text: saveChanges() fires this.get('embedding').update({}) without awaiting or catching the promise, and the server-side embedding#update action performs no work at all (it just re-renders the serializer). Any caller of saveChanges gets a fire-and-forget PUT whose failure is unhandled, and even on success the endpoint silently drops whatever was intended to be saved — an operation that reports success while doing no work.

However, the new `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` does not invoke `saveChanges` (it only has addHost and per-host save/delete handled via `embeddable_hosts_controller`), so this is not a clearly verifiable broken behavior from the diff alone—more an incomplete/unused action + no-op endpoint concern.
